1010.description: Boston Latin School is the oldest public school in America, founded in 1635. It is one of three exam schools in Boston (along with Boston Latin Academy and O'Bryant). BLS is a highly competitive 7-12 school known for rigorous classical education, strong college preparatory curriculum, and tradition of academic excellence.
1010.special_admissions: Exam school - requires ISEE/MAP scores and grades for admission. Application typically due in November.

1020.description: Boston Latin Academy is the second oldest public school in America, offering a rigorous college preparatory program. It is one of three BPS exam schools.
1020.special_admissions: Exam school - requires ISEE/MAP scores and grades for admission.

1030.description: The John D. O'Bryant School of Mathematics and Science is one of three BPS exam schools, with a focus on STEM education. Students take advanced math and science courses.
1030.special_admissions: Exam school - requires ISEE/MAP scores and grades for admission.

1040.description: Brighton High School offers career and technical education pathways. Recently received National Banner recognition from Special Olympics for inclusive programming.
1040.transportation: MBTA pass or yellow bus depending on distance

1050.description: Charlestown High School serves the Charlestown neighborhood with college preparatory and career pathways.
1050.transportation: MBTA pass or yellow bus depending on distance

1080.description: English High School is one of the oldest public high schools in the country, located in Jamaica Plain. Offers diverse academic and career programs.

1070.description: East Boston High School serves the East Boston community with strong ESL/ELL support given the neighborhood's diverse immigrant population.

1120.description: Burke High School in Dorchester, recently undergoing transformation efforts to improve student outcomes.

1162.description: Excel High School in South Boston offers small school environment with personalized learning.

1200.description: Snowden International School at Copley offers an international baccalaureate-style education with global perspective. Students must apply separately.
1200.special_admissions: Special application required - interview and essay process.

1210.description: Madison Park Technical Vocational High School is Boston's only vocational-technical high school, offering hands-on career training combined with academics.
1210.special_admissions: Students may apply starting in grade 8. Tour and information sessions available.

1420.description: Boston Arts Academy is Boston's only public high school for the visual and performing arts. Students audition for admission in one of four arts majors.
1420.special_admissions: Audition required in one arts major. Application typically due January.

1440.description: Kennedy Health Careers Academy prepares students for careers in healthcare. Students explore medical and health science pathways.

1460.description: TechBoston Academy is a pilot school offering technology-integrated education from grades 6-12.

4321.description: Alighieri Montessori School in East Boston offers a Montessori education approach for early learners, emphasizing hands-on, self-directed learning.

4381.description: Eliot K-8 Innovation School in the North End is one of BPS's most sought-after schools, known for strong academics, community involvement, and a diverse student body. It serves both the North End and waterfront neighborhoods.
4381.before_after_school: After-school programs available through community partners
4381.transportation: Walk zone / yellow bus for eligible students

4280.description: Harvard/Kent Elementary in Charlestown is a community school serving families in the Charlestown neighborhood.

4283.description: Warren/Prescott K-8 School in Charlestown. Recently received National Banner recognition from Special Olympics for inclusive programming for students with and without disabilities.

4323.description: Mario Umana Academy K-8 in East Boston. Recently received Special Olympics National Banner recognition and new piano lab for music education. Serves the diverse East Boston community.

4053.description: Hernandez K-8 School (Rafael Hernandez Two-Way Bilingual School) in Roxbury offers a dual-language immersion program in Spanish and English.

4580.description: Trotter K-8 School in Dorchester. Recently received Special Olympics National Banner recognition for inclusive education.

4650.description: Quincy Elementary School (Lower Campus K-5) in Chinatown serves a large Chinese-American community with strong bilingual programs.

1450.description: Quincy Upper School (grades 6-12) in Chinatown/South End, the upper campus of the Quincy school community, serves students with strong Asian heritage programs.

4610.description: Horace Mann School for the Deaf and Hard of Hearing in Allston serves deaf and hard of hearing students across Boston. Historic school with first deaf school leader in 151 years appointed in 2025.
4610.special_ed: Specialized school for deaf and hard of hearing students. Full range of special education services.
4610.special_admissions: Serves students who are deaf or hard of hearing. IEP referral typically required.

4261.description: Carter Center is a special education school in the South End providing intensive services for students with significant disabilities.
4261.special_ed: Substantially separate special education programs for students with significant needs.

1990.description: Boston International Newcomers Academy (BINCA) serves recently arrived immigrant and refugee students. Located in Dorchester.
languages: Native language support in Spanish, Haitian Creole, Cape Verdean Creole, Vietnamese, Chinese, Arabic, and more

1991.description: Newcomers Academy provides transitional support for recently arrived immigrant students before they enter other BPS schools.

4671.description: Mildred Avenue K-8 School in Mattapan serves the Mattapan community with a focus on academic achievement and community engagement.

4600.description: Young Achievers K-8 Pilot School in Mattapan focuses on science and math with a social justice lens.

4661.description: BTU (Boston Teachers Union) K-8 Pilot School in Jamaica Plain is a progressive, project-based pilot school.

4285.description: Mission Hill K-8 Pilot School in Jamaica Plain is a progressive pilot school known for experiential learning and democratic governance.

1053.description: Margarita Muñiz Academy in Jamaica Plain is a dual-language high school (Spanish/English) preparing students for bilingual careers and higher education.
1053.special_admissions: Open enrollment but designed for bilingual students.

1410.description: Boston Day and Evening Academy (BDEA) serves overage and under-credited students who need a flexible, alternative path to graduation.
1410.special_admissions: For students who are overage for their grade or need an alternative educational setting.

1470.description: Boston Green Academy is a Horace Mann charter school in Brighton focused on environmental sustainability and green careers.

1265.description: Fenway High School is a small pilot school in Mission Hill known for personalized learning and strong college placement rates.

4680.description: Orchard Gardens K-8 School in Roxbury underwent a major turnaround and is now considered a model of school transformation in Boston.

4570.description: Tobin K-8 School in Mission Hill/Roxbury serves a diverse community near the Longwood Medical Area.

1215.description: Boston Adult Technical Academy (BATA) provides alternative education for adult learners seeking GED or high school equivalency.
1215.special_admissions: For adult learners - age requirements apply.
